subject: Two quick questions after our discovery — where do we land?
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@claritypay.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Two quick questions after our discovery — where do we land?

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the clear description of ClarityPay's payout volume and security constraints. I wanted to do a very short recap and ask two quick, concrete questions so we can figure out next steps.

Recap (very short):
- Primary need: low-latency, high-throughput inference for invoice classification and refund routing (peak bursts up to ~400 concurrent requests).
- Constraints: SOC2 controls, data residency in US, budget window in Q3.
- Goal: decide if a pilot (2–4 week PoC) makes sense and who owns the technical evaluation on your side.

Two quick questions:
1) From a priority perspective, is this a Q3 pilot (high) or something you expect to deprioritize until Q4?
2) Who on your team should we loop in for a short technical trial plan (API keys, sample dataset, infra/ops contacts)?

If it helps, I attached a one-page discovery notes PDF that summarizes what we discussed and a sketch of a 3-step pilot plan (API trial -> small POC -> scale plan).

If you prefer, I can also book a 15-minute follow-up to walk through the pilot checklist — two slots I have this week: Wed 10:30–10:45 PT or Thu 14:00–14:15 PT.

No pressure — just trying to surface the decision rhythm so we don't miss your Q3 window if it's real.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (1 page summary)
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@claritypay.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Two quick questions after our discovery — where do we land?

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the recap and the notes — very helpful. We're still sorting Q3 priorities internally; payments ops is stretched right now. I expect Procurement and Security will want to review the pilot before we move forward.

Can you share a rough estimate for pilot cost and any required network/VPC setup? That will help me triage with our finance team.

I'll follow up with who should own the technical side, but it might be our Head of Payments (Amit) or our Platform lead.

Best,
Samira
Head of Business Ops | ClarityPay
samira.k@claritypay.com

Subject: Quick follow-up — any update on priority or pilot owner?

Hi Samira,

Just bumping this thread — wanted to check whether you've had a chance to prioritize the pilot internally, or if the timing has shifted. Short answers are totally fine: yes/no/move-to-Q4.

A couple of small help items if useful:
- Pilot estimate: typical 2-week trial for customers of your size runs $3k–$8k depending on traffic and whether you want dedicated capacity. I can confirm exact numbers once we scope expected peak QPS/sample volume.
- Network: for a simple API trial we can operate over TLS with strict IP allowlists (no VPC required). If you need VPC/private deployment, that's a slightly longer path we can scope once a pilot is greenlit.

If it's easier, I can open the calendar for a 10-minute sync next week. Otherwise, I'll assume this is low priority and check back in early July.

Thanks — appreciate the help in triaging this.

Alex
